decisions.reason: The schlager compilation CD sits close to the firm's core reissue business and was presented on its own page. In a growing retail market it costs little to keep a catalog item in the warehouse, and there is no evidence of a shortfall that would trigger problemistic search, so the satisficing choice is to keep it.

The illustrated release series builds on the established label and fits the firm's strategy of broadening formats. It has its own page and several models, and the industry is growing without any signalled difficulties, so results appear to meet aspirations and give no reason to drop it.
